title: SUNDERLAND BEAT CHELSEA 1-0. FIRST PREMIER LEAGUE WIN SINCE AUGUST!
description:
Beaten by Zagreb, then Chelsea beaten by Sunderland. Football does not do logic.

Brian Brobbey was brought down and Enzo Le Fee scored the penalty in the 36th minute. Job done, doors locked.

Sunderland came off the bottom. Chelsea fell out of the top four with a fourth league defeat. Days before, Sunderland had lost 2-0 at home to Dinamo Zagreb, and Regis Le Bris was under pressure with one win from nine.

Xabi Alonso denied Chelsea were bullied but admitted they could have defended better. Politely put.
